name: smoke
description: Synthetic, hand-written smoke dataset (2 conversations, 7 sessions, 14 questions) for exercising the eval pipeline end to end. It is NOT a benchmark: it is far too small and too easy for scores to be statistically meaningful or comparable with LoCoMo / LongMemEval results.

conversations.context: Personal journal entries written in the first person by the graph owner.

sessions.text: First day at my new job at Brightline Robotics, where I'm a firmware engineer. My manager is Priya Raman. I still live in my apartment in Porto's Bonfim district, about twenty minutes from the office by tram.
I adopted a rescue dog yesterday: a three-year-old greyhound named Biscuit. My sister Lena helped me pick him out at the Gaia animal shelter.
Priya asked me to lead the motor-controller rewrite at work. We're porting it from C to Rust. Nervous but excited. The deadline is the end of April.
Signed the lease and moved out of the Bonfim apartment: I now live in a small house in Matosinhos, so Biscuit finally has a garden. Lena is flying in from Berlin, where she lives, to visit me in May.

sessions.text: Platform sync. Decision: the billing service will migrate from PostgreSQL 12 to PostgreSQL 16. Owner: Tomás Ferreira. Target date: 15 July.
Platform sync. Tomás starts parental leave today and is out until August, so Aiko Tanaka takes over the billing migration. The target date slips to 29 July.
Platform sync. Incident review: last Thursday the staging cluster ran out of disk because audit logs were never rotated. Fix agreed: enable log rotation with 7-day retention.
